text: I am kindly asking for your support of my motion to authorize the installation of traffic calming (speed humps) along Edmund Avenue, between Avenue Road and Poplar Plains Road. Neighbours along Edmund Avenue have submitted a petition to my office demonstrating their support for traffic calming along their street. I have heard concern from the community regarding increased volumes and speed along Edmund Avenue. The street is frequently used as a shortcut to Avenue Road in the morning and evenings, and cars frequently speed to reach the traffic light at the end of the block. With the passage of this motion, the community will receive the traffic calming measures they have been organizing for.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of traffic calming (three speed humps) on Edmund Avenue, between Avenue Road to Poplar Plains Road, generally as shown in Attachment 2 to the letter (July 7, 2026) from Councillor Josh Matlow.
